2 Colour

Every colour token with its light and dark value, and the value in force under the current theme. Rendered from the token file embedded in this page.

Result colour scale · sequential, one hue, seven anchors, a scale never a verdict

Light: near-zero is the lightest step. Dark: the anchor flips, near-zero is the darkest teal, and in V1.1 the dark ramp is re-anchored one step down so that its brightest step sits below the edge line. Interpolation between anchors is in OKLCH.

The edge line on a coloured element · canvas.edge or canvas.edgeAlt, whichever reads better on the fill

Categorical · load kinds and cases · fixed order, never cycled

Validated with the dataviz validator against the canvas surfaces in both themes (adjacent pairlist: pass; all-pairs: the first three slots). Colour is never the only carrier of a load's kind: the arrow's form and its label carry it too.

6 Status and evidence labels · one table, three rules

Every label below is drawn from the labels table in the embedded tokens, and from nowhere else. The three rules: the raw token is reachable in place (the chip's tooltip, and its popover on a click); the authority domain is shown with the label, inside the chip; no label exists outside the table.

Raw tokenChipLabelAuthority domainKind
Solver·Model incompleteSolver·Mechanics solvedRule pack·Rule inputs incompleteRule pack·User-rule checkedRule pack·User-rule failedHuman·Human review required

Neutral for solved and checked: a solved model is information, not a green light. Amber for incomplete, red for a failed user rule, blue-grey for review required.

7 Proposal diff card · agent panel, 340 px column

Replace the rigid support at node 80 with a variable spring

“Can the riser at 80 move without loading the nozzle?”
Proposal P-12 · draft until accepted · 1 row in Layout, 1 row in Restraints · 16:22
Layout · node 80row 1 of 2 · accepted
DZ −2000 mmaccepted 16:31 · Undo
Restraints · node 80row 2 of 2 · pending
FieldOldNew
TypeRigidVariable spring
Cold load—4.2 kN
Library—TBD
Rationale

The rigid support at node 80 carries the thermal growth of the riser into the equipment nozzle. A variable spring at the design load lets the riser move and lowers the OPE1 ratio at node 40.

Constraints considered
  • Design pass load at node 80 from Run 03
  • Travel from OPE1 displacement, 12 mm
  • No vendor table is imported in this project
TBD
  • Vendor hanger table to select from (import through Libraries)
Schema and constraints: passed
Accepting a row changes the model. Results from Run 03 stay readable, marked stale, until the next run.
Accepted: P-09 · 11:40 · P-12 row 1 · 16:31 the record's last lines, under the open card

Before any row is decided the actions read “Reject proposal” and “Accept all rows”; a decided row collapses to a one-line receipt: the done check, the first changed field with its new value, a count when more fields changed (“+4”), and the time with Undo. The old value is in the receipt's tooltip and in the diff.

11 The canvas palette · the figure language, drawn schematically in 2D

Ground grid, pipe at real diameter with its edge line, a bend, restraint glyphs with direction arrows, a force and a moment vector with labels, neutral because result colour is on, node labels, a selection halo and a hover halo, the proposal ghost, the draft ghost as a thin dashed centreline with a faint tube outline and the hint strip on canvas.hint, the deformed shape with its undeformed ghost, result colour on two elements, an unsolved element, the triad and the scale reference. The edge and the drawn lines on the two result-coloured elements take canvas.edgeAlt; the compass carries its three buttons, Reverse, Place and Cancel, beside the length field, and a click on an axis handle makes it active. Every colour is a canvas token. not rendered by the engine
